findings.D9_cloud_base_eqv_precedence: FAST_SBM's cloud-base test at :4387 joins its terms with .and. around 'K_found .eqv. .FALSE.'; .EQV. binds more loosely than .AND., so the test is (SUP_WATER > 0 .and. w > 10 cm/s .and. K_found) .eqv. (.FALSE. .and. ...), whose right side is always false. KZ_Cloud_Base therefore ends as the highest level that is not (supersaturated with w above 10 cm/s), or 1, instead of the lowest level above the second that is. With the design's sounding the top level never saturates, so KZ is level 40 in every column at every call (the probe records show it) and the cloud-base branch never ran in 300 steps; with the c4 moist cap it runs once, at step 40, level 40, column c4, in both builds.
findings.falflux_bare_stop: FALFLUXHUCM_Z stops the run with a bare STOP when every fall speed is zero (:5360): the process exits with status 0 and no message (refusal case 6).
findings.spontaneous_breakup_bin: Spontanous_Init sets ikr_spon_break to the first bin with radius at least 0.3 cm, which on the 33-bin grid is bin 33 (3.25 mm). Spont_Rain_BreakUp does work only when bin 33 holds any positive value; in the float64 build that is almost every rainy call, in the float32 build noticeably fewer (the counts differ by build).
findings.still_air_has_no_diffusional_growth: Condensation and evaporation are driven only by the change of T and qv since the previous call (DIFFU = 0 when DIV1 equals DIV3, :4615). In a column with no advection since the last call (c3, still air) no drop grows or evaporates, even rain falling into 60 percent humidity: ONECOND1 is called 0 times in c3.

findings_cold.anti_bergeron_regime: ONECOND3's KCOND 50 (:8006-8016) prints 'Anti-Bregeron Regime, No DIFFU' and returns without growth. It needs DEL1N > 0 > DEL2N or an exact zero. FAST_SBM's saturation fits (2.53e12 exp(-5420/T) over water, 3.41e13 exp(-6130/T) over ice) cross at 272.96 K, about -0.186 C, and below that the water saturation pressure is the larger, so DEL1N > 0 > DEL2N is excluded wherever ONECOND3 is dispatched (below -0.187 C, :7908); between the two it is not. The sweep reaches KCOND 50 with stated inputs, KC-2 never does.
findings_cold.deldrop_reached_only_through_the_gmin_fl: In COAL_BOTT_NEW the drops lose mass in every cold collision, and the breakup step keeps a gain of at most 0.1 percent; the only other source of drop mass is coll_xxx_lwf's floor, which raises a bin left below gmin = 1e-13 to gmin. The deldrop check (:8598) fires only when those floors add more than 5 percent, which needs a very dilute spectrum and a very long step (refusal case 9).
findings_cold.graupel_build_dead_calls: In the graupel build FF5R is zero whenever COAL_BOTT_NEW runs (FREEZ's hail is merged into graupel after the collisions), so the drop-hail calls (:8524, :8534) never run; the two drop-graupel-to-hail calls (:8501, :8512) need ALWC of at least ALCR_G = 100 g/m3. In the hail build the graupel calls never run. KC-2 and KC-2g count each call site.
findings_cold.ice_nucl_stop_099_unreachable: ICE_NUCL stops with a bare STOP 099 (:3463) when a habit's crystal concentration, the running real(8) sum of 3 COL PSI2 xi over all 33 bins (:3375-3381, :3446-3452), changes by more than 10 per cm3 in one call. Nucleation adds DELTAF, at most HELEK1 = C1 exp(A1 + B1 DELSUPICE_MAX) = 1.106 per cm3, to bin 1 of one habit, and only when that habit's concentration is at most HELEK1 (:3435). With nonnegative bins that bounds every term, so the change stays at most 1.106. Finite bins of mixed sign reach the stop through rounding in the sum: a term of +1e17 (where the sum's spacing is 16) and a slightly larger negative term keep the concentration negative, and a bin-1 term just under 8 is absorbed before nucleation and adds 16 after it (refusal case 13 stops in both builds). A non-finite change reaches it too: a subnormal first grid mass makes 1/DX overflow (refusal case 1, the promoted build only; from a float32 grid the product cannot underflow in real(8), so the native build returns). FAST_SBM cannot reach the stop because it passes JERNUCL01_KS no crystals: FF2R is zeroed at every point (:4548-4550) and again after every nucleation call (:4667-4674), so FF2IN is zero on every call. The only crystals ICE_NUCL can then see are drops that JERNUCL01_KS's homogeneous freezing (:3101-3110) put into habit 2 in the same call, which happens only when its latent heat lifts the point from -38 C or below to -37 C or above; the nucleating habit is then habit 1 (below -22.4 C), which is zero, and habit 2 does not change.
findings_cold.jerdfun_negative_bin_with_growth: JERNEWF_KS's Kovetz-Olund remap (:2537-2573) moves only bins with FI > 0, so when any bin grows a negative bin is dropped without a refusal (the jerdfun_ice sweep's set 3). Its negative check (:2735-2751) fires when nothing grows (refusal case 2), and also when a bin's new mass passes the top of the remap's grid, RRS(NRX+1) = 1024 RRS(NRX) (:2515): the bracketing search then stops at the top bin, GMAT = (RRP - RN)/(RRP - RRTMP) is negative (:2564-2565) and the top bin can go negative. That needs a bin to grow by more than a factor of 1024 in mass in one call, which is extreme but not excluded. JERDFUN_KS's own check (:2426-2429) tests the same values after that check and so can never fire.
findings_cold.modkrn_unset_at_minus_40: modkrn_KS CASE 11 (:1481-1498) sets its output through INTERPOL_SE (:1362-1393), which assigns nothing when H equals its last node (-40 C): every test is strict and the last node is the smallest. At exactly -40 C the output keeps whatever the caller held (-1 in the sweep), as above 0 C, where modkrn_KS returns first (:1416-1417, finding D6). FAST_SBM calls COAL_BOTT_NEW for TT >= 233.15 K, so a point at exactly -40 C collides snow with snow using an undefined PRDKRN, and COAL_BOTT_NEW returns CollEff = PRDKRN (:8322) undefined there too.
findings_cold.onecond2_sign_flip_checks_unreachable: ONECOND2's two sign checks (:7522-7525 and :7608-7611) cannot fire: its drop rates are zero, so JERSUPSAT_KS takes the ice-only branch (or the no-rate branch), where DEL2N = DEL2 exp(-PI DT) keeps DEL2's sign, the dynamic terms being zero on every WRF call.
findings_cold.snow_breakup_guard_always_true: The snow-breakup guard (:4836) sums the slice FF3R(KR_SNOW_MIN:NKR), empty on the 33-bin grid (KR_SNOW_MIN = 34), so it is 0 > (33 - 34) 1e-30 and true at every point; BreakUp_Snow is then skipped because KR_SNOW_MAX = 35 > NKR. KC-2's counts show the guard true at all 15000 points of every tile column and no call.
findings_cold.supsat_small_ratio_branches_unreachable_: JERSUPSAT_KS's branches 8 and 9 (finding S1) need RI/RW at least 1e12 (or at most 1e-12) while the only-ice and only-water tests pass. In ONECOND3 RI/RW and PI/PW are the same ratio of ice to drop relaxation rates up to factors between 1 and 1.2, so for nonnegative spectra a ratio of 1e12 is sent to the only-ice (or only-water) branch first. Over ONECOND2 and ONECOND3, KC-2 reaches branches 0, 2 and 4 to 7 in both builds and precisions and never 8 or 9 (kc2.catalogue_counts); S2 (branch 7) is reached by real ONECOND3 calls.
